conventions.dateAuthorityRule: R1: a capability's planning date is the Aha! release date (product target), or the Aha! release date of a released capability (customer availability). Never Jira resolution, never a Salesforce commitment. R2: a project's roadmap window starts at its Jira start date, else the Aha! start date; it ends at its Jira due date, except the last project delivering a capability ends on that capability's planning date. R3: conflicts are flagged as exceptions and never rewrite the planning date.
conventions.unitConversion: none - no reviewed convention; hours and story points are never converted and story points are never compared across teams
